signature: public Flux<TelemetryRecord> latestHistory(String deviceId, Instant from, Instant toExclusive)
body:
return history(deviceId, from, toExclusive)
    .collect(
        LinkedHashMap<List<Object>, TelemetryRecord>::new,
        (latest, record) -> latest.merge(
            List.of(record.metric(), record.tDevice()),
            record,
            (current, candidate) -> candidate.revision() > current.revision() ? candidate : current))
    .flatMapMany(latest -> Flux.fromIterable(latest.values()));
